# MissUsingParentKeyword

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `MissUsingParentKeywordInspection`

`parent::m()` is meant for calling the overridden implementation of the
current method. When it calls some *other* inherited method that nobody in the
hierarchy overrides, it is equivalent to `$this->m()` / `self::m()`, and using
`parent::` there only misleads readers (and silently bypasses future
overrides).

## Example

::: code-group

```php{16,17} [Before]
<?php

class Widget
{
    public function paint($color) {}
    public static function registry() {}
    public function resize() {}
    public function layout() {}
}

class Button extends Widget
{
    public function layout()
    {
        parent::layout();
        parent::paint("red", 2);
        parent::registry();
        parent::resize();
        parent::missing();
        $fn = function () { parent::paint('x'); };
    }

    public static function build()
    {
        parent::paint('blue');
    }
}

class IconButton extends Button
{
    public function resize() {}
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

class Widget
{
    public function paint($color) {}
    public static function registry() {}
    public function resize() {}
    public function layout() {}
}

class Button extends Widget
{
    public function layout()
    {
        parent::layout();
        $this->paint("red", 2);
        self::registry();
        parent::resize();
        parent::missing();
        $fn = function () { parent::paint('x'); };
    }

    public static function build()
    {
        parent::paint('blue');
    }
}

class IconButton extends Button
{
    public function resize() {}
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 16: Call it as &#39;$this-&gt;paint(&#34;red&#34;, 2)&#39; instead of through &#39;parent::&#39;.</li>
<li>line 17: Call it as &#39;self::registry()&#39; instead of through &#39;parent::&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "MissUsingParentKeyword": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore MissUsingParentKeyword

/**
 * @noinspection MissUsingParentKeywordInspection
 */
```
